errors.evidence: The description provides an incorrect expansion for the acronym ПЧИ. In the context of the Bulgarian economy, ПЧИ stands for "Преки чуждестранни инвестиции" (Foreign Direct Investments), not "Приходи от чиста индустрия" (Revenues from clean industry).

errors.text_span: На графиката е изобразена една линия, която е тъмносиня, плътна и със засечени точки (маркери) във всяка точка на данни.
errors.evidence: The chart displays two separate visual elements: a scatter plot (the blue dots) and a line plot (the solid blue line). The description incorrectly describes them as a single series, a line with markers, when the line does not actually connect the centers of the dot markers.

errors.text_span: Линията започва в 2018 година при стойност, близка до 4 080 000 хиляди евро
errors.evidence: The solid line at the 2018 mark starts at a value of approximately 4,160,000. The value 4,080,000 corresponds to the lowest scatter plot point in 2018, not the starting point of the line itself.

errors.text_span: леко увеличаващ се наклон през годините
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the slope is slightly increasing over the years. Visually, the line has a constant, gentler slope until early 2019, at which point it kinks upwards and continues as a straight line with a steeper, but still constant, slope until 2022. The slope is not continuously increasing.
